load_entity_dict_zeshel: load entity documents from zeshel dataset worlds into a dictionary keyed by world id
create_Stats: create a Stats object to track retrieval ranking metrics across multiple recall thresholds
add_stats_hit: add a retrieval result index to the Stats object to update hit counts at each rank level
extend_stats: extend one Stats object by merging hit counts and example counts from another Stats object
output_stats: output a formatted string with total examples and recall-at-k metrics from the Stats object
